items.title: SLMs, Fine-Tuning & LLMOps: Building Production-Ready Language Models
items.summary: Not every use case needs a large model. Smaller and purpose-built is often faster, cheaper and better suited to the job. Terms covered: - SLM (Small Language Model): fewer parameters, trading breadth for precision. Runs on-premises or on edge devices with no cloud dependency. - SLM Development: designing, training and optimizing a small model for a well-defined task or dataset - Fine-Tuning Engine: taking a pre-trained model and training it further on domain-specific data, so it learns the language of law, medicine or your business - LLMOps: the infrastructure and practices for deploying, managing, monitoring and updating language models over time A hospital running clinical documentation on local servers. A manufacturer processing quality reports on factory floor devices. These are where compact models win. — AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University Full playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAWKlIKS-66E Free courses and certifications: https://h2o.ai/university #SLM #FineTuning #LLMOps #AIGlossary #H2Oai
items.summary_html:
Not every use case needs a large model. Smaller and purpose-built is often faster, cheaper and better suited to the job.

Terms covered:
- SLM (Small Language Model): fewer parameters, trading breadth for precision. Runs on-premises or on edge devices with no cloud dependency.
- SLM Development: designing, training and optimizing a small model for a well-defined task or dataset
- Fine-Tuning Engine: taking a pre-trained model and training it further on domain-specific data, so it learns the language of law, medicine or your business
- LLMOps: the infrastructure and practices for deploying, managing, monitoring and updating language models over time

A hospital running clinical documentation on local servers. A manufacturer processing quality reports on factory floor devices. These are where compact models win.

items.title: Build a game with Claude Code: Info session about HOPPy 6, starting October 4
items.summary: HOPPy (Hands-On Projects in Python) is all about learning by doing. Every cohort gives you a chance to build an application that you define, design, and produce. This time around, we'll use agentic coding (e.g., Claude Code) to create a game. Watch this info session from September 30th, where I describe how HOPPy works, why I designed it the way I did, and why you should join if you want to level up your agentic coding skills.

items.title: Garbage In, Gospel Out: Agents Are Your New Customers (Ep.1032 with Salesforce’s CDO Michael Andrew)
items.summary: During their #sponsored discussion, Chief Data Officer at Salesforce Michael Andrew talks to Jon Krohn about what changes for a data team when its customers are AI agents as well as people. Listen to the episode to hear Michael Andrew talk about why agents need ten times more trusted data than humans, how Salesforce untrapped its own customer data with Data 360 and what practitioners should be learning to stay effective in the agentic era!
